summary: Phase 5 backend testing: /api/search/suggest and /api/for-you endpoints validated end-to-end, plus light regression on /flash-deals, /verify/email/send, /ai/listing-suggest, /ai/photo-enhance, /orders/{id}/shipping-label, /orders/{id}/shipping-advance. All 19 pytest cases pass (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2645 lines — consider splitting into route modules (auth, listings, ai, shipping, search, recommendations) for maintainability.
/for-you: when both cat_ids and brands are empty the code sets '$or': [{}] before popping it — the pop handles it, but the ternary is confusing; consider building the query conditionally.

/search/suggest: no pagination/cursor; fine for typeahead but note that .distinct() over unbounded collection could get slow as catalog grows (add compound indexes on brand/category_name+status if not already present).
/search/suggest returns raw brand/category_name from listings — consider trimming/dedup case-insensitively (e.g., 'Nike' vs 'nike' would produce duplicate suggestion entries).
test_credentials: Used admin@mercari.local/admin123 and urban_finds@demo.local/demo1234; also registered fresh e2e_p5_* user at runtime for cold-start & favorite-bias tests.
seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral test user per session via /auth/register plus 2 favorite records; no other seed data added. Nike test relied on existing seeded 'Nike Air Max Running Shoes' listing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 endpoints (/search/suggest, /for-you) are stable. Regression endpoints (flash-deals, ai/listing-suggest, ai/photo-enhance, verify/email/send, shipping-label reachability, shipping-advance reachability) all passing. Frontend UI for the 4 approved items (Before Publish prompt, Personal Flash Feed, Sold-Out Confetti + share, Search Suggestions dropdown) was NOT tested — request explicitly asked for backend only. Next iteration should cover frontend UI wiring for these features.
